_comment: Every defect J reports about Night Shift's photographed room is added here as a permanent case, in the same change that fixes it.
tools/room-art.mjs (npm run test:room-art) runs every entry below and fails when one comes back. Never delete an entry: if the room
changes so an entry no longer applies, change its check, not its meaning. Types: maskCovers, chairWhole, zOrder, goneAfter, noDoubleImage.
acceptedStoryConflicts: a line whose speaker is out of the room for a reason the story text gives and the checks cannot see (named with
the reason); the check fails if the entry stops being needed.
